unit: 时态进阶 · 过去完成时
summary: 表示「过去的过去」：had + 过去分词。以过去某一时间为参照，在此之前已经完成的动作，是语篇填空与完形填空的高频考点。

rules.title: 结构与含义：「过去的过去」
rules.detail: had + 过去分词（had 不随人称变化）。表示在过去某个时间或动作之前已经完成的动作，必须有一个「过去参照点」。

examples.en: By the time he arrived, the train had already left.
examples.zh: 他到达时，火车已经开走了。

examples.en: She had learned English for five years before she went abroad.
examples.zh: 出国之前她已经学了五年英语。

rules.title: 常用时间标志：by / before / when
rules.detail: by the time + 过去时、by the end of + 过去时间、before + 过去动作，都提示「到过去某时为止已完成」，用 had done。

examples.en: By the end of last term, we had learned about 3,000 English words.
examples.zh: 到上学期末为止，我们已经学了大约 3000 个英语单词。

examples.en: He had finished his homework before his mother came back.
examples.zh: 在他妈妈回来之前，他就已经写完作业了。

rules.title: 宾语从句中的过去完成时
rules.detail: 主句用过去时（said / told / found / realized...），从句动作发生得更早时用 had done；in the past few years 等完成时标志在从句中也随之变为过去完成时。

examples.en: She told me that she had read the book twice.
examples.zh: 她告诉我那本书她读过两遍了。

examples.en: He realized that he had taken the wrong road.
examples.zh: 他意识到自己走错了路。

rules.title: 固定句型：hardly...when / no sooner...than
rules.detail: hardly had + 主语 + done...when + 一般过去时；no sooner had...than...。都表示「刚……就……」，前半句用过去完成时并倒装。

examples.en: Hardly had I got home when it began to rain.
examples.zh: 我一到家就下起雨来了。

examples.en: No sooner had she sat down than the phone rang.
examples.highlight: No sooner had she sat down

pitfalls: by the end of last year 用现在完成时：❌ has finished → ✓ had finished
过去完成时滥用：没有「过去的过去」参照点就不用 had done，只出现 yesterday 等一般过去时间时仍用一般过去时
hardly...when 前后时态颠倒：❌ Hardly I had got home when it began to rain. → ✓ Hardly had I got home when it began to rain.

rows.l: 过去某时发生的动作本身
rows.r: 过去某时之前已完成的动作（过去的过去）

rows.l: When I arrived, the meeting started.（我到了，会议才开始）
rows.r: When I arrived, the meeting had started.（我到之前会议就开始了）
by then / by the end of last... / before + 过去动作

questions.stem: By the end of last month, they ___ over 2,000 words.
questions.explain: by the end of last month 表示到过去某时为止，用过去完成时 had learned。

questions.stem: She told me that she ___ the book twice before she was fifteen.
questions.explain: 「读」发生在 was fifteen（过去）之前，是「过去的过去」，用过去完成时。

questions.stem: — Did you meet Mr. Smith in his office? — No, he ___ by the time I got there.
questions.explain: 「离开」发生在「我到那儿」之前，过去的过去，用 had left。

questions.stem: Hardly ___ the classroom when the bell rang.
questions.explain: hardly...when 句型：hardly 置于句首时用倒装 had he entered，且用过去完成时。

questions.stem: When I got to the cinema, the film ___ (be) on for ten minutes.
questions.explain: got to 是过去，电影「已经开始十分钟」发生在它之前，用过去完成时 had been。

questions.stem: He said that great changes ___ (take) place in his hometown in the past few years.
questions.explain: in the past few years 常配完成时；主句 said 是过去时，从句用过去完成时 had taken。

questions.stem: By the time the police arrived, the thief ___ (run) away.
questions.explain: 小偷逃跑发生在警察到达之前，过去的过去，用 had run。

questions.stem: When she rushed into the station, the train has left.
questions.explain: 火车开走发生在「她冲进车站」之前，是过去的过去，用 had left。

questions.stem: 到上周为止，我们已经完成了这个项目。（翻译整句）
answer: we had finished the project by last week.
we had completed the project by last week.
questions.explain: by last week 提示到过去某时为止，用过去完成时 had finished。
